pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Fireflies.ai pricing starts at $0 (Free), $10/user/month (Pro, billed annually), $19/user/month (Business, billed annually), and $39/user/month (Enterprise, billed annually)… Pro runs $18/month with monthly billing, and Business runs $29/month"

nl.tagline: AI-notulist met zoekbare gesprekken en CRM-koppelingen
nl.description: Fireflies neemt deel aan je online meetings, transcribeert ze, maakt samenvattingen en zet actiepunten door naar je CRM of projecttool. Alle gesprekken worden doorzoekbaar, handig voor sales- en klantteams.
notFor: Wie geen bot in vergaderingen wil
limitations: Prijzen per seat; Enterprise alleen jaarlijks

en.tagline: AI notetaker with searchable conversations and CRM sync
en.description: Fireflies joins your online meetings, transcribes them, writes summaries and pushes action items to your CRM or project tool. All conversations become searchable, handy for sales and customer teams.
notFor: People who don't want a bot in meetings
limitations: Priced per seat; Enterprise annual only
